newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Vivus raised to buy. [CORRECTED 17:27 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Vivus raised to buy. [CORRECTED 17:27 GMT]

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it upgraded Vivus Inc to buy from hold.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- After the market closed on Tuesday, Vivus posted first quarter earnings of $0.54 a share, topping analysts' consensus estimate of $0.20 a share and surpassing last year's loss of $0.45 a share.
(corrects year ago period to a loss)
-- Vivus gained 6-5/8 to 48 in early morning trading.
